verdict.rationale: Vercel documents an official remote MCP server at https://mcp.vercel.com with OAuth, one-command setup, documented client configurations, and a broad tool inventory covering projects, deployments, logs, analytics and domains. A live probe confirms the endpoint answers with OAuth-protected-resource metadata per the MCP authorization spec. missing for 10: independent community corroboration of real-world use, and support for arbitrary MCP clients (access is limited to a Vercel-reviewed allowlist).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Vercel's official MCP server. It's a remote MCP with OAuth that gives AI tools secure access to your Vercel projects available at: https://mcp.vercel.com
a live, OAuth-gated remote MCP server per the MCP authorization spec
Connect your AI tools to Vercel using the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard that lets AI assistants interact with your Vercel projects.
Each tool documents parameters and a sample prompt.
